description: For every finite arity \(n\), an \((n+1)\)-ary relation \(R\) gives a unique output \(y\) for every input tuple \(\bar x\in M^n\) if and only if a unique function \(f:M^n\to M\) satisfies \(R(\bar x,y)\leftrightarrow y=f(\bar x)\), where \((\bar x,y)\) appends the output as the last coordinate.
